third_party.description: Boolean value is "true" if the product is facilitated by a Booking.com partner company and "false" otherwise.

type.description: Type of inventory - either net or sell rates.

reservation.description: This is the reservation id for the accommodation in this order.

affiliate.description: The affiliate id used for this order.

address.description: The booker's address for showing the best price for that user and obeying laws regarding the display of taxes and fees.

language.description: A [IETF language tag code](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/IETF_language_tag) that uniquely identifies a supported human language or dialect. **Note:** Demand API only accepts lowercase for the language codes. Examples: "nl" for Dutch/Nederlands or "en-us" for English (US). To retrieve the full list of supported languages, call the `/common/languages` endpoint in the same Demand API version you are using.

platform.description: The booker platform for showing the platform based deals and prices.

travel_purpose.description: The travel purpose of the booker.

reservation.description: This is the reservation id for the car in this order.

commission.description: Commission details for the partner for a given order.

actual_amount.description: For accommodation: This is the final commission for this order (`null` if value is not yet available). For other travel services: It represents the estimated commission before billing and the final commission after billing.

estimated_amount.description: Estimated commission amount for this order. For accommodations, it will be `null` if the final commission amount is available.

currency.description: Input currency used in "commission" and "price" output fields.

reservation.description: This is the reservation id for flight in this order.

loyalty_reward.description: Details of the loyalty rewards associated with this order.

amount.description: Reward amount, in the units of the specified reward type (such as cash, mile, point, etc.).

eligible.description: Whether the order is eligible for the reward.

fulfillment_at.description: Date and time at which the reward should be fulfilled.

fulfillment_by.description: Mode of fulfillment of the reward.

loyalty_data.description: Loyalty data associated with this loyalty reward used to fulfill reward.

payment.description: The payment details of this order.

accommodations.description: The accommodation specific payment details of this order.

authorisation_form.description: Link to the authorisation form of the order.

receipt_url.description: Link to the payment receipt of the order. `This will only be added if the payment is already charged.`

reservation.description: Reservation ID for this accommodation order.

method.description: The payment method of this order.

paid.description: The paid transactions for this order.

transaction_currency.description: Currency in which the transaction took place.

pending.description: The pending transactions for this order.

transaction_currency.description: Currency in which the transaction took place.

timing.description: The payment timing of this order.

price.description: The price components of this order.

commissionable.description: The commissionable price. Order price on which commission amount is calculated.

total.description: The total price. Includes all extra charges.

updated.description: Time the order was last updated.
